summary: Real dated trigger (TPT Basic/Exclusive split, 31 Dec deadline), but no evidence anyone pays for tier math or migration help, and the calculator is free-substitutable. The decision window closes before a 14-day test finishes, and David has no seller reach.

demand.evidence: Petition (1,523 signatures) and Chalkbeat anger are interest in the policy, not demand for a tool; RESEARCH admits no seller said they'd pay.

statusQuo.evidence: Free spreadsheet/ChatGPT does the tier math in minutes; migration pain is inferred from a Gumroad-to-Shopify guide; CSV import on target platforms unconfirmed.

specificity.evidence: Persona is clear (established TPT seller, 30-300 resources, Premium opt-in screen) but unnamed, and the buyers who leave TPT are the unevidenced subset.

wedge.evidence: Wedge is the listing pack, not the free calculator; M1 as scoped ships the free part.

futureFit.evidence: Urgency is a one-time policy cliff that decays after 1 Jan 2027; TPT may soften terms.

premises: Sellers face a real money decision by 31 Dec: supported, with secondary-source fees.
No free personalised answer exists: weak, the math is trivial.
Hand migration is painful enough to pay $19: inferred, not evidenced.
A solo developer can reach sellers in time: unsupported.
Sellers will leave exclusivity to sell elsewhere: unclear, other storefronts bring no buyers.
alternatives: Minimal: free calculator page posted in seller groups to test reach and questions first.
Ideal: calculator + listing pack + fee-refresh subscription (higher risk, seasonal).
Lateral: one marketplace-seller landing page shared with landfall/ownshot/packpass so one audience effort serves several ideas.
wedge: Listing-pack-only: paste a catalogue sheet, get Payhip/Etsy-ready copy and fee-adjusted prices for $19; calculator stays free.

feasibility.notes: Static Vite/TS on Cloudflare Pages/Vercel, fees.json, Vitest. Proof test: 245.00 Basic / 387.50 Exclusive 77.5% / 400.00 at 80% / break-even 43, and no network calls. M1 is the free part; paid demand sits in M2.

risks: 31 Dec deadline leaves no time to act on a 14-day test
Free substitutes make the calculator worth $0
TPT may soften terms or sellers default to Basic
killCriteria: Fewer than 3 $19 pre-orders or 8 signups from 100 qualified visitors in 14 days; TPT relaxes off-platform restriction; target platforms offer CSV import making the pack redundant.
